<noinclude>
Template for displaying equipment information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Equipment
|name=Confocal Microscope
|type=Microscope
|manufacturer=Zeiss
|model=LSM 980
|serial_number=SN123456
|location=Room 201
|status=Active
|owner=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]
|purchase_date=2023-06-15
|cost=250000
|last_maintenance=2025-01-10
|next_calibration=2025-07-10
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* name - Equipment name (required)
* type - Equipment type (required)
* manufacturer - Manufacturer name
* model - Model number
* serial_number - Serial number
* location - Physical location
* status - Status (Active, Inactive, Archived)
* owner - Link to personnel page
* purchase_date - Purchase date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* cost - Purchase cost (number)
* last_maintenance - Last maintenance date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* next_calibration - Next calibration date (YYYY-MM-DD)

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
